title: Describe a useful room
intro_questions: What do people use this room for?
cue: Describe a real or imagined room that is useful for studying or meeting people.
points: what furniture and equipment it contains
followups: How can shared spaces help people learn?
What problems can a crowded room cause?
How might the needs of a large group differ from those of one learner?
checks: I developed an answer rather than giving only a list.
I used countable and uncountable nouns accurately.
I used quantity expressions with the right noun forms.
I paused to organise ideas and corrected myself when necessary.
